question: What will be the closing value of the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) (^VIX on Yahoo Finance) on August 29, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of ^VIX on Yahoo Finance for 2026-08-29. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't get the resolution page itself. Yahoo Finance, FRED, YCharts and Barchart all refused the connection through the proxy. The figures below come from secondary sources. Several search results were dated after 2026-08-08, and I left them all out.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-07 (Fri): Seeking Alpha reports a VIX close of **14.90**, its lowest close of 2026 so far. The S&P 500 closed at a record 7,757.64 the same day. [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/article/4939568-nasdaq-option-income-case-for-short-volatility-as-vix-sinks-to-14-90)
- 2026-08-06: YCharts shows 15.15. The prior session (2026-08-05) was 15.81. [YCharts](https://ycharts.com/indicators/vix_volatility_index)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. About 15 trading days remain before resolution. The VIX sits near its 2026 low, at about 14.9.
- 2026-08-08: CNBC says the VIX fell on Friday to its lowest level since January, during a record week for options volume and an S&P 500 surge. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/08/record-breaking-week-for-options-powers-sp-500-surge.html)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-07: The S&P 500 gained about 3.6% in the week ending August 7, its best week since April. [KuCoin blog](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/sp500-record-high-vix-low-midterm-market-correction)
- Late July 2026: A Kayne Anderson review says the VIX stayed low even with large single-stock moves, because those moves largely offset each other. [Kayne](https://kayne.com/wp-content/uploads/07-2026_Market-Review-Commentary-IM.pdf)
- 2026-07-20: The VIX fell 8.6% to 17.05 in a tech-led rally. [Tapeboard](https://tapeboard.com/blog/market-pulse-2026-07-20)
- 2026-07-17: The VIX jumped about 12% to 18.77 in a tech sell-off. [Tapeboard](https://tapeboard.com/blog/market-pulse-2026-07-17)
- 2026-07-08: Trump called the Iran ceasefire understanding "over". India VIX jumped 26%, showing geopolitics is still a source of spikes. [Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/india-vix-surges-26-as-trumps-iran-ceasefire-over-remark-rattles-markets-sensex-nifty-slump-over-2-541766-2026-07-08)
- March 2026: The Iran-related spike took the VIX to an intraday high of 28.57 on March 6 and a close of 24.92 on March 26. One aggregator also reports a Friday close of 31.05, which I could not verify. [AOL](https://www.aol.com/finance/iran-tanker-attacks-sent-vix-234835922.html), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/wall-streets-fear-index-hits-230000328.html)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026 range: about 14.9 at the low (Aug 7) and about 25-31 at the highs (March). From May to July the VIX mostly traded between 15 and 19.
- Swings over a few days are large. The VIX went from 15.0 to 18.8 to 17.1 within about a week in mid-July (sources above).
- General pattern (my summary of long VIX history, not a sourced figure): when the VIX starts near 15, its change over 3 weeks is skewed to the upside. The middle 80% of outcomes is typically about 12.5 to 20. The median tends to drift slightly higher, toward its long-run average, which is about 17-19 on a median/mean basis. Spikes above 25 within 3 weeks from a starting level of 15 are uncommon but do happen, for example August 2024 and April 2025.
- Late August has a mixed seasonal record. Liquidity is thin, which can amplify shocks, as in August 2015 and August 2024.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices for this date. Kalshi runs VIX range markets, but I couldn't retrieve their historical prices.
- VIX futures: Barchart's August 2026 contract (VIQ26) had a period low of 16.85 on 2026-08-07. That is above spot, which means the futures curve was in contango and the market expected some drift higher. The September contract price was not retrievable. [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/futures/quotes/VI*0)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Mid-August (around Aug 12-14): July CPI and PPI, on the regular BLS schedule. I did not confirm exact dates.
- Aug 26 (after the close): Nvidia's fiscal Q2 earnings, according to one secondary preview. Check this against Nvidia's investor relations page. [Regards of Wall Street](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/news/jackson-hole-2026-dates-schedule-warsh-first-speech)
- Aug 27-29: Jackson Hole symposium. Kevin Warsh gives his first keynote as Fed Chair on **Friday Aug 28 around 10:00 a.m. ET**, the same day as the resolving close. [XTB](https://www.xtb.com/en/education/jackson-hole-2026-warsh-fed-speech), [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/full-jackson-hole-symposium-schedule)
- Late August: July PCE inflation from the BEA, likely the week of Aug 24-28. I did not confirm the exact date.
- Ongoing: US-Iran headlines, the run-up to the midterm elections, and how concentrated the AI/tech trade has become.
